headline: Law Enforcement / Customs Digital Arrest Extortion
summary: Impersonator claimed victim package contained illicit drugs and coerced immediate fund transfer to avoid police arrest.
verifiedObservations: Victim received threatening WhatsApp call and fake arrest warrant
aiInferences: Matches active Indian Cybercrime Coordination Centre (I4C) high-priority alert for Digital Arrest syndicates
unknowns: Actual identity behind VoIP call numbers

prioritizedActions.title: Do not transfer money or share Aadhaar/OTP
prioritizedActions.description: Police and customs never conduct digital arrests over video calls or demand money.

prioritizedActions.title: Dial 1930 to report the extortion numbers
prioritizedActions.description: National Cyber Crime Helpline blocks scammer numbers immediately.
